description: Create a new category in a blog publication. seoTitle/metaDescription/intro/noindex can also be set later via update_blog_category.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

intro.description: Long-form hub body copy rendered under the H1, taking precedence over `description`.

metaDescription.description: Overrides the hub page's generated meta description when set and non-empty.

noindex.description: Set true to serve the hub page with robots noindex.

seoTitle.description: Overrides the hub page's generated <title> when set and non-empty.

name: create_blog_category
